# **DEVPOST RULES EXTRACT — Codegeist 2025 (Canonical Verbatim)**

*Source: Official Devpost Codegeist 2025 pages* ([codegeistxawr.devpost.com][1])

---

## **1) WHAT TO BUILD / PROJECT REQUIREMENTS**

* “Build an app using Atlassian’s Forge platform and integrate with at least one Atlassian product or platform capability (Jira, Confluence, Jira Service Management, Bitbucket, or Compass) in one of the following categories:” ([codegeistxawr.devpost.com][1])

### **Categories**

* *Apps for Software Teams* – build apps that help software teams perform like a finely tuned pit crew—fast, precise, and always in sync. ([codegeistxawr.devpost.com][1])

* *Apps for Business Teams* – build apps that keep business teams aligned, moving fast, and making the right calls when it matters most. ([codegeistxawr.devpost.com][1])

* *Apps for Specialized Industries* – build apps tailored to the unique demands of specialized industries. ([codegeistxawr.devpost.com][1])

* “The Sponsor and Administrator reserve the right to reassign a Project from one Category or Bonus Prize to another if applicable.” ([codegeistxawr.devpost.com][2])

* “Functionality: The Project must be capable of being successfully installed in a judge’s test environment via an installation link, it must run consistently on the platform for which it is intended, and it must function as depicted in the video and/or expressed in the text description.” ([codegeistxawr.devpost.com][2])

* “Platforms: A submitted Project must run on Atlassian Forge as specified in the Submission Requirements.” ([codegeistxawr.devpost.com][2])

---

## **2) WHAT TO SUBMIT**

* “Access. Provide access to an installation link for the judges and review team to test your application.” ([codegeistxawr.devpost.com][1])
* “Demo Video. Include a video (under 5 minutes) that demonstrates your project and any relevant bonus prize specifics. Videos must be uploaded to YouTube or Vimeo, and made public.” ([codegeistxawr.devpost.com][1])
* “Category. Identify which category and bonus prizes you are submitting to. Provide any necessary materials for the bonus prizes.” ([codegeistxawr.devpost.com][1])
* “Submit. Before the deadline, complete the entire submission form on Devpost and include your App ID located in the Developer Console.” ([codegeistxawr.devpost.com][1])

---

## **3) BONUS PRIZES (AS LISTED)**

* “6 Best Runs on Atlassian Apps: $2,000 to 6 projects that also meet the requirements of the Runs on Atlassian program.” ([codegeistxawr.devpost.com][1])
* “6 Best Rovo Apps: $2,000 to 6 projects that use Forge rovo:agent and action modules to configure agents and enable agents to perform specific tasks.” ([codegeistxawr.devpost.com][1])
* “6 Best App built using Rovo Dev: $2,000 to 6 projects that were built using Rovo Dev. Submission must include (1) a summary explaining how Entrant used Rovo Dev for the Project and (2) a link to a social media post about Entrant’s use of Rovo Dev.” ([codegeistxawr.devpost.com][1])

---

## **4) PRIZES**

* “$120,000+ in prizes” ([codegeistxawr.devpost.com][1])

### **Prize Tiers**

* *1st Place*

  * “$15,000 USD”
  * “2 tickets TEAM 2026 (AMER) for first-place winners (travel not included)”
  * “Recognition at Atlas Camp 2026”
  * “Signed limited edition Atlassian Williams Racing swag” ([codegeistxawr.devpost.com][1])

* *2nd Place*

  * “$8,000 USD”
  * “Opportunity to be featured on the winner announcement on the Atlassian blog” ([codegeistxawr.devpost.com][1])

* *3rd Place*

  * “$5,000 USD”
  * “Opportunity to be featured on the winner announcement on the Atlassian blog” ([codegeistxawr.devpost.com][1])

* *Bonus Prizes:*

  * “Best Runs on Atlassian Apps – $2,000 in cash, 6 winners” ([codegeistxawr.devpost.com][1])
  * “Best Rovo Apps – $2,000 in cash, 6 winners” ([codegeistxawr.devpost.com][1])
  * “Best App built using Rovo Dev – $2,000 in cash, 6 winners” ([codegeistxawr.devpost.com][1])

* *Participation Prize*

  * “300 winners – Atlassian Developer Swag Pack”
  * “Awarded on a first-come, first-serve basis to Entrants of Eligible Submissions, including participating members of a Team or Organization, while supplies last (max 4 per Submission).” ([codegeistxawr.devpost.com][1])

---

## **5) JUDGING CRITERIA**

* “Judging Criteria”

  * “Quality of the Idea – Includes creativity and originality of the idea.”
  * “Implementation of the Idea – Includes how well the idea was executed by the developer.”
  * “Potential Impact – Includes the extent to which the solution can help the most Atlassian users.” ([codegeistxawr.devpost.com][1])

---

## **6) KEY DATES (AS PROVIDED)**

* “Submissions: October 27 at 8:00AM PDT – December 22 at 10:00AM PST.” ([codegeistxawr.devpost.com][3])
* “Judging: January 19 at 1:00PM PST – January 30 at 12:00PM PST.” ([codegeistxawr.devpost.com][3])
* “Winners Announced: February 09 at 9:00AM PST.” ([codegeistxawr.devpost.com][3])

(Alternative community reference:

* “Submission Deadline: 10AM PT (UTC-8), Monday 22nd December, 2025”
* “Winners Announced: Monday 9th Feb, 2026.”) ([The Atlassian Developer Community][4])

---

## **7) SPONSOR & ORGANISER (NOT EXPLICITLY LISTED ON Rules Page)**

* Sponsor: Atlassian (as indicated by event title & official posts) ([codegeistxawr.devpost.com][1])
* Administrator: Devpost (implicit on Devpost hosted hackathon page) ([codegeistxawr.devpost.com][1])

---

# **RULES MINIMUM BASELINE (Explicit, Verbatim)**

**Eligibility Minimum:**

* Build an app using Forge integrated with at least one Atlassian product or capability. ([codegeistxawr.devpost.com][1])

**Submission Minimum:**

* Provide installation link, video under 5 min on YouTube/Vimeo, category selection, App ID. ([codegeistxawr.devpost.com][1])

**Functionality Minimum:**

* Must install, run consistently, and match video/text description. ([codegeistxawr.devpost.com][2])

**Judging Minimum:**

* Evaluated by judges based on idea quality, implementation, and impact. ([codegeistxawr.devpost.com][1])

**Deadline Minimum:**

* Submit by 22 Dec 2025 at 10:00AM PST. ([codegeistxawr.devpost.com][3])

**Prize Minimum:**

* Eligible for cash prizes down to participation swag pack. ([codegeistxawr.devpost.com][1])
